title: POIs drawer
description: Point of interest editing for markers, annotations, and route story moments.

ui.overview: The POIs drawer is where you edit the points of interest that support the route story. It covers the marker data, the visual state, and the details that keep a POI useful in the scene and in exports.

controls.label: Title and category fields
controls.description: Lets you name the POI and choose the category that best describes it.

controls.label: Coordinates fields
controls.description: Lets you review or edit the POI position and related location values.

controls.label: Visibility switch
controls.description: Shows or hides the POI without deleting it from the journey.

controls.label: Focus POI
controls.description: Centers the camera on the selected POI for review or adjustment.

controls.label: Description and journey fields
controls.description: Stores the POI text and, where relevant, the journey it belongs to.

controls.label: Coordinates and altitude
controls.description: Edits the marker longitude, latitude, and height. Copy buttons help reuse the coordinates.

controls.label: Copy coordinates
controls.description: Copies the POI coordinates so you can reuse them in another tool or field.

controls.label: Show / Hide Filters
controls.description: Shows or hides list filters for global POIs or journey-related POIs.

controls.label: Search POIs
controls.description: Searches the POI list by its content from the filter panel.

controls.label: POI actions
controls.description: Depending on the POI state, provides Show/Hide, Focus, Orbit, Copy Coords, Reduce/Expand, and Remove.

controls.label: Bulk actions
controls.description: Applies an action to multiple selected POIs when multi-selection is available.

steps.title: Select a POI
steps.description: Choose a marker in the list, then use Focus to find it in the scene.

steps.title: Edit its fields
steps.description: Update the title, description, category, coordinates, altitude, and associated journey.

steps.title: Filter the list
steps.description: Open Show Filters, search for a POI, and choose whether global or journey POIs should be included.

steps.title: Use POI actions
steps.description: Use the POI menu to hide it, move the view to it, copy its coordinates, or remove it.

notes: Use POIs to support story moments, points of interest, or map annotations.
Check the POI presentation before export so important markers remain readable.
